description: This Java source file defines the class SearchErrorResponse, which represents an error response to a ThingSearchCommand in the Eclipse Ditto framework. It encapsulates a DittoRuntimeException that occurred during a search operation and provides methods for serialization/deserialization, equality checks, and access to the inner exception.

classes.name: SearchErrorResponse
classes.description: An immutable class representing an error response for a ThingSearchCommand, containing a wrapped DittoRuntimeException and supporting JSON serialization/deserialization.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory method to create a new SearchErrorResponse from a DittoRuntimeException and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Deserializes the error response from a JSON string or object along with headers.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new instance of SearchErrorResponse with updated headers.
